PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . ?s ex:age ?a . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:email ?e } BIND (IF(?a >= 30, "old", "young") AS ?grp) FILTER (datatype(?a) = xsd:integer) } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:score ?sc . MINUS { ?s a ex:Admin } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:score ?sc . ?s ex:knows ?o . BIND (?sc + 0.25 AS ?scp) OPTIONAL { ?s ex:age ?a2 FILTER (?a2 > 20) } FILTER (?o != ex:carol) } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:email ?e } MINUS { ?s ex:age ?m FILTER (?m < 20) } FILTER (!bound(?e)) } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . ?s a ex:Person . MINUS { ?s ex:age ?m FILTER (?m < 20) } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . MINUS { ?s a ex:Admin } ?s ex:knows+ ?r . ?s ex:address/ex:city ?city . } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . BIND (?a / 3 AS ?third) FILTER (?a = 30 || ?a = 41) } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:knows ?k FILTER (?k != ?s) } FILTER EXISTS { ?s ex:knows ?x } MINUS { ?s a ex:Admin } } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . MINUS { ?s ex:age ?m FILTER (?m < 20) } FILTER (datatype(?a) = xsd:integer) ?s ex:knows+ ?r . } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . ?s ex:score ?sc . MINUS { ?s ex:age ?m FILTER (?m < 20) } OPTIONAL { ?s ex:name ?ln FILTER (lang(?ln) = "uk") } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . ?s ex:name ?n . { SELECT ?s (COUNT(?f) AS ?nf) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?f } GROUP BY ?s } BIND (?a / 3 AS ?third) } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . ?s ex:score ?sc . BIND (ROUND(?sc / 2) AS ?half) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s ex:email ?x } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . FILTER (?o != ex:carol) FILTER EXISTS { ?s ex:knows ?x } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:score ?sc . ?s ex:age ?a . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:name ?ln FILTER (lang(?ln) = "uk") } { SELECT (MAX(?ma) AS ?oldest) WHERE { ?p ex:age ?ma } } OPTIONAL { ?s ex:knows ?k2 . ?k2 ex:age ?ka FILTER (?ka > ?a) } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . ?s ex:score ?sc . FILTER (?sc >= 7) } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:score ?sc . FILTER EXISTS { ?s ex:knows ?x } VALUES ?s { ex:alice ex:bob ex:frank } { ?s ex:email ?u } UNION { ?s ex:score ?u } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:score ?sc . ?s ex:knows ?o . FILTER EXISTS { ?o ex:knows ?s } } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . ?s ex:knows+ ?r . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s ex:email ?x } { ?s ex:email ?u } UNION { ?s ex:score ?u } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . ?s ex:knows+ ?r . FILTER (?o != ex:carol) OPTIONAL { ?s ex:name ?ln FILTER (lang(?ln) = "uk") } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . ?s a ex:Person . BIND (COALESCE(?e, "none") AS ?ce) BIND (?a * 2 AS ?a2x) } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . { SELECT (MAX(?ma) AS ?oldest) WHERE { ?p ex:age ?ma } } ?s ^ex:knows ?in . } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . ?s ex:knows+ ?r . FILTER EXISTS { ?s ex:knows ?x } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:name ?n . ?s ex:knows ?o . OPTIONAL { { ?s ex:score ?os FILTER (?os > 5) } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s ex:email ?x } FILTER (?o != ex:carol) } GROUP BY ?s

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . ?s a ex:Person . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:name ?ln FILTER (lang(?ln) = "uk") } FILTER (?o != ex:carol) } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s a ex:Person . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s ex:email ?x } ?s ex:knows+ ?r . OPTIONAL { ?s ex:name ?ln FILTER (lang(?ln) = "uk") } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (SAMPLE(?s) AS ?x) WHERE { ?s ex:age ?a . ?s ex:name ?n . { ?s ex:email ?u } UNION { ?s ex:score ?u } } GROUP BY ?s HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1)

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ex:knows ?o . ?s ex:knows/ex:name ?fn . ?s ^ex:knows ?in . } GROUP BY ?s
